findings.title: Missing Required Build and Lint Verification
findings.issue: The approved plan (ui-modernization-plan.md, Phase 10.5, line 400) explicitly requires verification via 'npm run build && npm run lint'. No evidence of this mandatory verification was provided by the implementer. Without build verification, the application may fail to compile in production, contain TypeScript errors that break at runtime, have missing dependencies or broken imports, or include ESLint violations.
findings.evidence: Searched for build/lint output in .agents/tasks/ directory and found no verification files. Grepped for 'npm run build', 'npm run lint', 'build success', 'eslint' in project documentation and logs - no execution evidence found.
findings.consequence: Production deployment may fail. Runtime errors may occur. Code quality cannot be verified. TypeScript type safety not confirmed. Import resolution not validated.
findings.correction: Run 'npm run build && npm run lint' in the project root directory. Provide complete console output showing: (1) Successful build completion with no errors, (2) ESLint execution with no warnings or errors, (3) All TypeScript types resolving correctly, (4) All imports valid. Document output in .agents/tasks/build-verification.txt or similar file.
findings.triggeringPath: Phase 10.5 of approved plan mandates this verification as a success criteria before approval. This is a mandatory gate requirement per plan line 400-402.

reviewerNotes: Implementation demonstrates high quality with comprehensive coverage of all modernization phases. Design patterns are consistently applied. All user requirements from original messages have been addressed. However, the mandatory build/lint verification gate has not been satisfied. Once verification is provided showing successful build and no errors, this implementation should be approved.
